verdicts.human_summary: The test only checks that some error is thrown; it should assert the actual error message to catch unintended error changes.
verdicts.reasoning: The human comment is about making the test assertion more specific by checking the actual error message string (e.g., .toThrowError('specific message') instead of .toThrowError()). The closest AI comment (Comment 3) addresses the same test but raises a fundamentally different concern — that zero values shouldn't throw at all because they don't cause D3 crashes. No AI comment addresses the specificity of the error assertion.
